verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a payments SaaS that processes customer and transaction data and markets AI-driven optimization, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented setting, policy, or contractual control that keeps merchant or customer data out of AI model training. The AI-related material (MCP server, agentic commerce, AI-driven acceptance optimization) is about other capabilities and does not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
